question: How many days before opening a new restaurant do I have to apply for a permit?

before.answer: The documents I have do not cover this. Please consult your local health authority or the FDA Food Code for permit application timelines in your jurisdiction.

searches.query: permit opening new restaurant days before
permit application timeline days before opening

after.answer: You must submit an application for a permit at least 30 calendar days before the date planned for opening a food establishment [food_code_2022_chapter_8, §8-301.11 to 8-302.13, pp. 5-6].
